# `jouet edit replace`

- **Usage:** `jouet edit replace <FLAGS> <PATH>`

Replace text in one file, given on the command line

Matches anywhere in the file, like `str::replace`, and requires exactly one match unless --count or --all says otherwise.

## Arguments
- **`<PATH>`** — The file to edit

## Flags
- **`--old <TEXT>`** — The text to find
- **`--new <TEXT>`** — The text to put in its place
- **`--count <N>`** — How many matches there must be
- **`--all`** — Replace every match (at least one)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
